classPassive.name: Infinity Indicator EX
classPassive.detail:
Space Ereshkigal possesses a Master Affinity Gauge. This gauge starts at Level 1 and maxes out at Level 10. Performing specific actions with Space Ereshkigal boosts Master Affinity; the level goes up every ten points. Her Master Affinity Level resets after each battle.

Ways to Raise Master Affinity:
- Raise Bond Level to 5 (+5)
- Set her as a starting member (+5)
- Bring her into battle on a [Near Water] field (+10)
- Successfully select one of her Command Cards (+3)
- Form a Brave Chain with her (+6)
- Use any of her skills (+3)
- Use her skills first (+2)
- Use her Noble Phantasm with Overcharge (+5 per level)
- Target her with a Master Skill effect (+5)
- Target her with a Command Spell effect (+10)

Note: Space Ereshkigal will not have a Master Affinity Gauge in Friend Support mode. Her initial Master Affinity Level will be set to 0 and cannot be increased.
